chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Safwan, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar, who said:
I asked Aba Ibrahim عليه السلام about the fornicator: how is he to be flogged? He said, “With the severest flogging.” I said, “Over the clothes?” He said, “No, rather he is stripped.”

key_terms.أَشَدَّ الْجَلْدِ: the severest flogging; an intense form of lashing
key_terms.الثِّيَابِ: clothes; garments worn on the body
key_terms.الزَّانِي: the fornicator; the person guilty of zina
key_terms.يُجَرَّدُ: he is stripped; his clothing is removed before punishment
key_terms.يُجْلَدُ: is flogged; receives the prescribed lashes

ai.seo_question: How should the hadd flogging of a fornicator be carried out according to Imam Aba Ibrahim عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the manner in which the hadd punishment for zina is carried out. Imam Aba Ibrahim عليه السلام states that the flogging is to be severe and not administered over clothing, indicating that the punished person is to be stripped for its execution.
